subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should OpenClaw accept the question/plan/goal parity rollout as one core PR with `update_plan` default-on and new `goalDriver` config, or split/narrow it first?
rationale: The branch adds new user-facing modes, public SDK surface, channel behavior, session state, and config/default changes; code review can identify blockers, but final rollout shape is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Split After Blockers
options.body: Fix the P1 blockers, then split question, plan, and goal rollout into staged PRs with focused proof and compatibility review.

options.title: Land As One Feature
options.body: Accept the broad PR shape after the blockers, live Slack proof, and explicit SDK/default-surface approvals are resolved.

options.title: Extract And Close
options.body: Keep the roadmap issue open, extract only narrow accepted pieces, and close this PR if the combined branch remains too risky to maintain.

recommendation.title: Split After Blockers
recommendation.body: Fix the P1 blockers, then split question, plan, and goal rollout into staged PRs with focused proof and compatibility review.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the plugin SDK and agent-tool boundary most affected by the remaining API decision.
